name: Yuuji-kun no Pet.
source:
Yuuji just can't help himself around pretty boys. And there's one right here, his friend Io!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE276928.html]DLsite English[/url]]
